# Shadow Flow

> Apache 2.0 open-source visual workflow engine for deterministic AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), n8n workflow compatibility, and sandboxed WebAssembly runtimes.

## Documentation & Core Capabilities

- [Visual DAG Canvas](https://shadowflow.work/features): Graph-based canvas with multi-model routing, conditional branches, and sub-20ms node execution.
- [Universal Integrations](https://shadowflow.work/integrations): Connects 50+ REST APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, databases, and webhook listeners.
- [Documentation & Quickstart](https://shadowflow.work/docs): Self-host via Docker, npm, or cloud runtimes with zero telemetry.
- [Interactive Canvas Demo](https://shadowflow.work/demo): Test live DAG execution in browser with instant topological layout.
- [AI SEO Studio & Content Engine](https://shadowflow.work/seo-agent): Built-in GEO citability auditor, SE Ranking content brief generator, and 82-rule humanizer.
- [API Reference](https://shadowflow.work/api-reference): Full OpenAPI specs for webhook triggers and workflow execution contracts.

## Technical Engineering Blog

- [Code vs Canvas: Comparing LangChain and Visual DAG Builders for Enterprise Multi-Agent Systems](https://shadowflow.work/blog/langchain-vs-visual-dag-workflows-code-vs-canvas): An objective performance and maintenance comparison between code-first frameworks and visual node canvases for team-wide automation handoff.
- [Building an Autonomous B2B Lead Enrichment Pipeline with Webhooks, Clay, and Resend](https://shadowflow.work/blog/building-autonomous-b2b-lead-generation-crm-pipeline): Complete architecture for automating inbound webhook capture, domain scraping, contact enrichment, and transactional email routing with sub-second execution.
- [Fixing Broken AI Pipelines for Free: Deterministic Graph Repair with the Zero-Cost Heuristic Engine](https://shadowflow.work/blog/deterministic-graph-repair-zero-cost-heuristic-engine): Why relying on recursive LLM calls to fix syntax errors is expensive and slow, and how deterministic graph analysis resolves missing connectors instantly.
- [Serverless DAG Orchestration: Sub-50ms Workflow Execution on Cloudflare Workers and D1](https://shadowflow.work/blog/serverless-dag-orchestration-cloudflare-workers-d1): How running directed acyclic graph execution on Cloudflare edge isolates memory, prevents container cold starts, and scales without VM overhead.
- [Migrating from n8n to Shadow Flow: 100% Apache 2.0 Freedom with Zero Workflow Re-Writes](https://shadowflow.work/blog/migrating-from-n8n-to-shadow-flow-guide): A comprehensive migration playbook showing how Shadow Flow's Universal n8n Importer and Kahn auto-layout preserve your existing node configurations and trigger bindings.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) in Production: Wiring Real-World Tools into Drag-and-Drop AI Pipelines](https://shadowflow.work/blog/model-context-protocol-mcp-visual-workflows): An architectural deep dive into connecting Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to visual DAG nodes for secure tool-augmented multi-agent execution.
- [Building 100% Offline AI Workflows with Local Ollama, Gemma 4, and Zero-Cost Heuristics](https://shadowflow.work/blog/building-offline-ai-workflows-local-ollama-gemma4): How to build resilient visual automation pipelines that run completely offline with private Ollama inference and deterministic graph repair with $0.00 cloud API bills.
- [How to Build an Autonomous Deep Research Pipeline with Webhooks, Firecrawl, and Claude 3.5](https://shadowflow.work/blog/building-autonomous-deep-research-pipeline-webhooks): A step-by-step production blueprint for scraping live web intelligence, cross-referencing citations with Perplexity, and delivering automated executive briefs.
- [Deploying DeepSeek Reasoner in Enterprise AI Automation](https://shadowflow.work/blog/deepseek-reasoner-enterprise-ai-automation): Architectural analysis of running DeepSeek-R1 for multi-step reasoning at one-tenth standard API cost.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) vs Function Calling](https://shadowflow.work/blog/mcp-vs-function-calling-architecture): Benchmarks and state management patterns for tool-augmented AI workflows.
- [Why Self-Hosted AI Workflows Beat SaaS Lock-in](https://shadowflow.work/blog/self-hosted-ai-workflows-vs-saas): Latency, cost, and compliance comparisons between self-hosted engines and cloud-only automation platforms.

## AI Search & MCP Integration

- [Model Context Protocol](https://shadowflow.work/docs#mcp): Connect visual workflows directly to MCP tools.
- [API Reference](https://shadowflow.work/api-reference): REST API endpoints and webhook delivery contracts.
